statement.zh: 塔尔罕晚前王朝—早王朝墓地发掘见 Petrie《塔尔罕》I 与《孟菲斯》V（1913）及《塔尔罕》II（1914）。
statement.en: At Tarkhan, Late Predynastic–Early Dynastic cemetery excavations are documented in Petrie Tarkhan I and Memphis V (1913) and Tarkhan II (1914).
